land.text: the former realm of Balhae (Bohai) in eastern Manchuria: Cliopatria's last Balhae outline (922..925)

predecessors.note: 'After conquering Balhae in 926, the Liao crown prince Yelü Bei ascended to the throne of Dongdan at the Huhan fortress.' Cliopatria ends Balhae in 925 and draws this outline as Liao from 926 (jk-02-c notes).

land.text: the former realm of Balhae (Bohai) in eastern Manchuria: Cliopatria's last Balhae outline (922..925)

successors.note: 'was annexed by the Liao dynasty in 936.' The infobox also names Jeongan as a successor (Balhae people 'created the Jeongan kingdom soon after the dissolution of Dongdan', no date or place): no land is assigned to it here.

capitals.name: Huhan fortress (Balhae Shangjing, Ning'an)
capitals.note: Infobox 'Huhan (926-928)'; the page links Huhan to Shangjing Longquanfu, Balhae's Upper Capital, whose coordinates in the balhae dossier are used.

capitals.name: Liaoyang
capitals.note: Yelü Deguang 'ordered his elder brother to move his capital from Huhan in eastern Manchuria to Liaoyang in western Manchuria' (no date in the text; infobox 928). Yelü Bei fled to North China in 930; his son reigned before the annexation.

correction.text: the former realm of Balhae (Bohai) in eastern Manchuria: Cliopatria's last Balhae outline (922..925)

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Dongdan row; it draws this outline as Liao from 926). The page says 'the former realm of Balhae (Bohai) in eastern Manchuria' and carries no area ('Dongdan is shaded in blue' is the only map caption). Some historians cited on the page doubt Dongdan was ever independent ('annexed in 926') and a minority put its annexation in 982; both are noted, not followed. After the 928 capital move the realm's centre of gravity is Liaoyang in the south-west of the outline.

region.text: the former realm of Balhae (Bohai) in eastern Manchuria: Cliopatria's last Balhae outline (922..925)

ledger.note: 926: the Khitans make Balhae the puppet kingdom of Dongdan. 'After conquering Balhae in 926, the Liao crown prince Yelü Bei ascended to the throne of Dongdan at the Huhan fortress'; infobox 'a puppet kingdom established by the Liao dynasty'. The page gives no month.

928: the capital is ordered from Huhan to Liaoyang. 'Yelü Deguang (Emperor Taizong) ordered his elder brother to move his capital from Huhan in eastern Manchuria to Liaoyang in western Manchuria'; infobox 'Liaoyang (928-936)'; the text gives no date for the order.

region.text: the former realm of Balhae (Bohai) in eastern Manchuria: Cliopatria's last Balhae outline (922..925)

ledger.note: 936: Liao annexes Dongdan. 'was annexed by the Liao dynasty in 936.' A minority of historians put it in 982, others in 926; the page prefers 936.

region.text: the former realm of Balhae (Bohai) in eastern Manchuria: Cliopatria's last Balhae outline (922..925)

ledger.note: 936: the Dongdan kingdom ends. 'The Balhae people created the Jeongan kingdom soon after the dissolution of Dongdan'; no year or place on the page.

wars.name: Khitan conquest of Balhae and Dongdan

zones.text: the former realm of Balhae (Bohai) in eastern Manchuria: Cliopatria's last Balhae outline (922..925)

wars.outcome: Liao conquers Balhae in 926, rules it through the puppet king Yelü Bei and his son, and annexes it in 936.

certainty.note: Inherited Balhae outline; the page gives no boundary.

sources.title: Dongdan Kingdom
sources.note: Infobox 926-936; Huhan and Liaoyang; Yelü Bei's flight in 930; annexation 936; Jeongan.

notes: Colony (Khitan puppet kingdom) on the Balhae outline, 10 years. One page opened (the Dongdan page), against a budget of 2: the Liao and Balhae pages are in other groups' dossiers. The Dongdan page is silent on the Later Tang, on Balhae refugees and on the Heungyo kingdom (1029). Jeongan (Balhae refugees, 'soon after' 936) needs a dossier of its own (suggested slug jeongan): no page opened here dates or places it. Liao's own dossier (ea-05) should carry the vassal tint; Cliopatria's Liao shape from 926 already contains this land.
